subject.title: Reject unsupported diagnostics OTel grpc config

question: Should OpenClaw retire the shipped `diagnostics.otel.protocol: "grpc"` contract now and migrate existing configurations to the HTTP-only canonical shape?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but automation cannot decide whether the project should remove a shipped configuration promise and rewrite enabled telemetry settings rather than preserve the contract by implementing gRPC export.

options.title: Approve HTTP-only retirement
options.body: Accept the schema restriction and doctor migration because gRPC export never functioned, while preserving stdout-only logging and giving existing configurations an actionable repair path.

options.title: Preserve and implement gRPC
options.body: Keep `grpc` accepted and pause this PR until the diagnostics plugin provides a working gRPC exporter with fresh-install and upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep warning-only behavior temporarily
options.body: Retain the current accepted value and runtime warning until a separately approved deprecation window and migration policy are defined.

recommendation.title: Approve HTTP-only retirement
recommendation.body: Accept the schema restriction and doctor migration because gRPC export never functioned, while preserving stdout-only logging and giving existing configurations an actionable repair path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is recent ownership of adjacent diagnostics OTel exporter behavior and configuration surfaces.
